def cache_handle_uri(handle):
    """
    Convert a 'cache handle' from a binary string to a string URI
    """
    handle_hex = binascii.b2a_hex(handle)
    purpose = convert_fourcc(handle_hex[0:8]) # first 4 bytes
    region = convert_fourcc(handle_hex[8:16]) # next 4 bytes
    content_hash = handle_hex[16:]
  
    uri = ''.join([
        'http://',
        region.lower(),
        '.depot.battle.net:1119/',
        content_hash.lower(), '.',
        purpose.lower()
      ])
    return uri

limitations: The modern regional endpoints are documented template instantiations, not proof the exact US object exists in those regions.
Legacy plainHTTP depot routes are a historical client-library format; redirects will not be followed and authentication is not attempted.
No undocumented/internal/storage/GCP hosts are inferred from third-party host lists.
